row: Eden Farmed Animal Sanctuary, the first vegan sanctuary in Ireland, opened in 2008. It is home to more than two hundred courageous, unique, special beings, all of whom have been rescued from human use. You can connect with them and their lives through these videos. They are no different to the billions of animals used and killed every year by humans every year. The only difference between the animals at Eden and those who are exploited and killed by us is that the rescued animals' rights are respected and they have someone to tell their story. Go Vegan.
